## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage4 grinder optimized for wide P&L by tightening stops, increasing profit targets, and adding volume filters. The hypothesis is that these changes improve edge by capturing more premium on winning days while limiting losses through faster exits and stricter entry quality. However, the OP-16 edge_capture reveals poor performance on J's anchor days, suggesting the optimizer found a regime-dependent edge that does not generalize to the source-of-truth trades.

## Mechanism

- **Entry:** Requires volume ratio ≥ 1.2 (current bar volume / 20-bar average volume > 1.2)  
- **Strike:** ITM-2 puts (strike_offset=2)  
- **Stop:** Premium stop at -35% (stop_premium_pct=-0.35) OR time stop at 12 minutes  
- **Exit:** Take profit at +75% premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75) with chandelier profit-lock arming at +60% (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6)  
- **Position sizing:** Assumed 3-contract minimum per risk-rules.md (actual quantity unknown without grinder logs)
